Neighborhood Witness
Case: State v. Petri

Witness Name: John Smith
Address: 123 Main Street, Cityville
Date of Statement: January 15, 2024

STATEMENT:

I observed the defendant in the area of the incident on the date specified in the complaint. The witness provided additional testimony regarding timeline events and vehicle identification marks.

Bystander Account
Case: State v. Petri

Witness Name: Maria Rodriguez
Occupation: Retail Worker
Date of Statement: January 20, 2024

STATEMENT:

I was working my shift at Lakeside Market on February 28, 2024 when I observed a vehicle matching the plate number mentioned in the case files. The witness heard arguments between individuals and saw one of the defendants exit the vehicle. Additional testimony includes timing estimates and vehicle departure direction.

Signed: Maria Rodriguez
Date: January 20, 2024
